description: This source file defines an abstract class 'DisabledTransactionsTestRunner' within the 'Orleans.Transactions.TestKit' namespace. The class provides methods to test transaction behavior when transactions are disabled, specifically checking that certain grain operations throw 'OrleansTransactionsDisabledException'.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionsTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract test runner class for scenarios where transactions are disabled, extending 'TransactionTestRunnerBase'.

methods.name: TransactionGrainsThrowWhenTransactions
